description: Install SideStore, LiveContainer or any IPA on an iPhone/iPad from the PC and manage pairing files.
notes: iloader talks to the device through Apple Mobile Device Support (usbmuxd). Upstream asks for iTunes;
scoop install -g gesu/Apple-Mobile-Device-Support   (AMDS alone, from an elevated shell)
Apple Devices app (winget install 9NP83LWLPZ9K): should work too, upstream does not mention it
If Windows sees the iPhone/iPad only as a camera/MTP device, the USB driver is missing:
scoop install gesu/Apple-Mobile-Drivers-Installer   (then run it as administrator)
Decline the update offered inside iloader: its installer would put a second copy outside Scoop.
Settings and logs live in %APPDATA%\me.nabdev.iloader and are kept on uninstall.
